userOutcome: A dependent project step waits for the explicitly corrected preceding task and consumes its result once.
preserved: Existing scheduler, correction journal and task execution.
Explicit cancellation and ordinary stop remain terminal.
Historical blocked work is not silently restarted.
implementation: Per-execution advisory boundary spans stop, correction recording and resume scheduling.
Dependency readers try the boundary lock and wait instead of racing or blocking the owner scheduling lock.
Only recorded correction resumes with matching execution/source/parent/generation are followed.

tests.scope: Real disposable PostgreSQL; controlled tasks/results. No generated document or real conversation model.
cases: Direct-work and schedule dependencies survive correction.
Scheduler between stop and correction recording cannot prematurely block the child.
Corrected predecessor result is transferred and child admitted once.
Ordinary stop, dependent cancellation and correction cancellation preserve terminal outcomes.
Existing restart admission and household correction/stop cases.

review.scope: Source, concurrency/cancellation provenance and test review; no remaining concrete blocker.
review.limitation: Advisory boundary prevents live races but does not make separate writes crash-atomic. Mid-correction process failure recovery not proven.

limits: General multi-day autonomous project completion and owner acceptance remain open.
Previously blocked project steps are retained, not automatically reactivated.
